FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LEGAL STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE FACULTY POSITIONS IN THE SUBJECT OF
LAW
Faculty positions No. of
seats
Honorarium Duration*
Guest Faculty (Law) 02 Rs. 1500/- per lecture
subject to maximum of
Rs. 50,000/- per month
Even Semester of
session 2023-24
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.
(https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulation-
2018-9-2.pdf )
All the applicants are advised to send/submit hard copy of their applications to
the Director, University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh along with all self attested copies of their certificates and other
relevant documents including publications for verification along with the duly
filled application form and template pages 1 to 11
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf)
on or before 4th March, 2024 by 4:30 p.m. Late applications will not be
considered and will stand rejected.
The Interview for appointment of Guest Faculty to teach B.A.LL.B (Hons.) and
B.Com.LL.B. (Hons.) will be held on 7th March, 2024 at 11 a.m. in University
Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
At the time of interview (physical presence of the candidate is mandatory). The
candidates are required to bring all the supporting
documents/certificates/publications in original. Candidates are required to
report at 10:30 a.m. sharp on the date of interview at UILS Office. The
candidates are advised to keep checking the Panjab University and UILS website
for further updates.
The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are
teaching at University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh
as a Guest Faculty.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Extendable as per Panjab University Rules/Norms.
-Sd-
Director
